asr.full_text: on how the one coin back office works the back office is where you run and build your business it's therefore needless to say that you should have a deep understanding of all the features the back office has to offer let's have a look. tutorial profile and settings page this is your profile and settings page some important settings can be changed here so let's take a look at the automatically register in your organization. Keep this link with you at all times, and send it to your future team partners. Placement of new members. Sometimes it can be important to strategically place people in your team. OneCoin has made it very simple for you to place people in the most strategic position by selecting alternatively right or left. This means that the system will see which side is the best position at that time and places your new team member there. We recommend you to build your team this way, especially if you are new to the business, as you will avoid mistakes by following this method. If you want to place your new members at a specific side, left or right, simply use that strategy. Automatically buy. By defaulty by default auto buy a set on last use package tokens which we highly recommend to do changing password and transaction password your password is the key to your business and we recommend to keep changing that key quite frequently by changing your password once in a while you You will prevent fraud and theft. You can easily change your password in this section by typing your current and new password. Your transaction password is different from your account password. You use the transaction password to approve transactions for coins, tokens, etc. We also recommend to change this password once in a while. Change email here you can easily change your email state your new email address as well as your transaction password you will be sent an email for you to confirm this change of email address make sure to confirm accordingly to successfully change your email address change user info this works like any other profile changing your name address and all other relevant information can be done here it's very important to make sure this information is correct since this information will be used to make transactions to your bank account don't forget to fill in your passport ID as well OneCoin will never share this information with third parties. Bank Detail This is where you state all the information about your bank. So OneCoin is able to transfer your comissions and earnings to your bank account. Make sure all information is filled in correctly. IBAN and SWIFT codes are the International codes for banks. If you are not sure which IBAN or SWIFT code your bank uses, we recommend you asking your bank. Furthermore, make sure that you are using a bank account that matches your user info, as OneCoin requires this information to match in order for you to successfully cash out through your personal bank account. KYC stands for know your customer which is widely used to prevent credit card fraud By doing a kyc you tell one coin who you are By uploading a recent utility bill and a copy of your id card or passport This procedure is necessary to make sure your funds are paid out to you only

textual.observation: The source presents OneCoin as a business opportunity and instructs users to send an organization link to future team partners and build a team by placing new members.

evidence.quote: OneCoin provides a once in a lifetime opportunity, revolutionizing the business world of todays digital economy.
Keep this link with you at all times, and send it to your future team partners.
We recommend you to build your team this way, especially if you are new to the business

textual.context: Promotional tutorial context is present; the source does not establish whether the opportunity or team-building claims are accurate.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed business opportunity is linked to recruiting future team partners and building a team, which may require later assessment of the recruitment and return structure.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish compensation terms, required payments, actual recruitment outcomes, or whether the described activity is ordinary business promotion.

textual.observation: The source instructs users to provide identity, bank-account and verification information so OneCoin can transfer commissions and earnings and process cash-out.

textual.context: The instructions are presented as account, banking and KYC tutorial steps. The source attributes the privacy statement and payment process to OneCoin; no independent verification is provided.
textual.potential_relevance: Promises of commissions, earnings and fund payout are linked to requests for passport or ID, a utility bill, bank details and KYC submission, creating a concrete money-and-sensitive-data relationship for later review.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the information was actually submitted, whether funds were paid, whether the statements are accurate, or what safeguards applied.

visual.observation: A branded account profile interface visibly requests and provides save controls for bank details, including bank name, country, IBAN/account number and SWIFT code; nearby profile fields request identity and personal information including date of birth, address, place of birth, country of birth and passport ID.
visual.context: The sampled frames show an account-settings/profile form; the purpose of collecting these fields is not stated.
visual.potential_relevance: The platform links submission of sensitive identity and banking information to an account profile, creating a data and financial-information collection flow that may merit review in context.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the information was actually submitted, how it would be used, whether the platform is legitimate, or whether any loss or misuse occurred.

visual_context_notes.observation: The interface is branded OneCoin and includes profile settings, password controls, transaction-password controls, email changes and bank-detail settings.

An invite-link section displays a signup link and a button referring to signing up a new member with the account holder as sponsor; a separate screen depicts alternate left/right placement in a member network.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents OneCoin as a business opportunity and instructs the account holder to recruit team partners and build a team. It shows sponsor sign-up and member-placement controls alongside purported commissions, earnings, payouts, and KYC requirements for identity documents and a utility bill. The material does not establish that information was submitted, funds were paid, or the claims and privacy assurances were independently verified.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central demonstrated mechanism is building and arranging a multi-person OneCoin team, including placing new members in left/right positions, while the same offer describes commissions and earnings being transferred to a bank account. The tutorial also instructs users to enter their current account password, supporting an account-access or sensitive-data cue as a secondary subtype.
